remarks: Nestled at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac, this secluded home offers a perfect blend of modern amenities, serene living and a convenient location. The skylit south facing living room, bathed in light from the large windows with cozy fireplace & vaulted ceiling welcomes you into a space designed for comfort and relaxation. As you enter the updated kitchen, showcasing the custom spalted maple cabinets, granite countertops, copper sink, stainless steel appliances and dining area w/sliders to the spacious IPE deck and patio, overlooking private 1.8 acres, perfect for all your outdoor entertaining. Warm & inviting family room has easy access to kitchen and patio. The primary bedroom is a true retreat, boasting a vaulted ceiling, a second fireplace, walk-in closet, full bathroom with jetted tub, separate shower stall, and skylight that bathes the space in natural light. Two additional bedrooms, full bath and gleaming hardwood floors complete the main level. Unfinished lower level offers storage, potential for customization, separate in-law apartment and 2 car garage. Recent updates include a water heater, water storage tank and windows, ensuring the home is move-in ready. Don't miss the opportunity to own this private oasis, combining the best of comfort and style in a tranquil setting. HIGHEST & BEST DUE BY NOON ON 8/28/24.
